items.source: Obtains the domain type information from the given method parameter. Will favor an explicitly registered on through QuerydslPredicate.root() but use the actual type of the method's return type as fallback.
items.translation: 从给定的方法参数获取域类型信息。将优先通过 QuerydslPredicate.root() 显式注册的内容，但会使用方法返回类型的实际类型作为后备选项。
